#!/bin/bash

set -o errexit
set -o nounset

if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    wget "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID/start" -T 10 -t 5 -O /dev/null
fi

cd /app

/app/transcode.sh -c
/app/transcode.sh -r

# Send completion ping to healthchecks
if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    wget "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" -T 10 -t 5 -O /dev/null
fi

#!/bin/bash

set -o errexit
set -o nounset

if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    curl --silent --max-time 10 --retry 5 "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID/start"
fi

python /app/script.py \
    -H $HOST \
    -k $API_KEY \
    -o $BACKUP_LOCATION \
    --secret-seed --root-keys \
    --keep 90

# Send completion ping to healthchecks
if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    curl --silent --max-time 10 --retry 5  "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID"
fi

Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices (this one)

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
